context: The main _run_one_simulation_step conductance matvecs (main E/I, main non-EI, graded, slow-NMDA-recurrent, coincidence, graded-plateau, GABA_B) were ALREADY routed through the deterministic helper under the flag (commits fa0168a20 2026-08-25 + 06ce99c76 2026-08-27). Megakernel-v2 (default-on) accumulates each post-neuron's incoming edges sequentially in CSR order in double => already order-stable. The GPU-only opt-in megakernel-v1 fast path was the LAST conductance matvec still on cuSPARSE csrmv under the flag (only .tocsr()-ed). This edit closes it.

microdemo_matvec_level_cupy.description: Distinct SHA256 hashes over 8 repeated identical calls of each transpose SpMV on one fixed random CSR (fan-in 48). >1 == run-to-run non-deterministic.
microdemo_matvec_level_cupy.reading: The cuSPARSE TWO-COLUMN transpose csrmv (W.T @ fired_2col -- exactly the megakernel-v1 E/I path) is non-deterministic run-to-run (8/8 distinct) at BOTH N; the reduceat helper this edit routes to is byte-stable (1/1). The 1-column csrmv happened to be stable at this fan-in (density-dependent; the 2026-08-25 gap#5 finding measured 1-col non-determinism at density 0.9).

megakernel_v1_end_to_end_cupy.config: N=5200 (>4968), IZH read-only megakernel-v1 (enable_step_megakernel=True, v2=False, read_only_fast_step=True, fast_spike_reset=True), inhibitory on, all plasticity off, seed 4242, dt 1.0

before_flag_off_preedit_path.reading: The pre-edit path injects run-to-run FP jitter into continuous conductance state (g_e diverges); at 40 steps/N=5200 it had not yet amplified into a spike (firing) flip -- consistent with the 'long spiking read amplifies past ~4968 into a 1-spike divergence' mechanism.

numpy_no_regression.config: N=6000 (>4968), main _run_one_simulation_step, inhibitory on, seed 4242, 60 steps
numpy_no_regression.reading: On numpy the matvec is order-stable regardless of the flag, so the divergence cannot be reproduced there (this is why the 2026-08-27 numpy merge batch could not see it); the flag-ON deterministic path agrees with flag-OFF within f32 rounding and flips no spike. Confirms the edit changes nothing observable on numpy and at small N.
